ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (>90% dark) with high-intensity outliers (white) concentrated at fluke tips and linear surface streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-gray field across the ventral plane; high-contrast white geometric blobs concentrated at the outer lateral coordinates (tips).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central vertical depression forming a U-shape; depth-to-width ratio approximately 1.5:1 with a narrow base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged trailing edge boundary with variable amplitude serrations; notably sharp peaks at the distal ends and rounded valleys near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed white circular clusters at both distal tips representing barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel sets of high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) on the left lobe surface; sporadic unaligned streaks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral extremities and multiple sets of linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Small isolated high-intensity circular points on the right lobe surface, distinct from the tip clusters.
